rows.before: Under section 125 the first $500,000 of active business income carries a combined Ontario rate near 12.2%, where the top personal rate reaches 53.53%.
rows.after: Under section 125 the first $500,000 of active business income carries a combined Ontario rate near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), where the top personal rate reaches 53.53%.
rows.note: First R1 change on page; parenthetical added.
